items.source: The short Java class name is mapped to the table name in the following manner. The com.bigbank.SavingsAccount class maps to the SAVINGS_ACCOUNT table name. The same name mapping is applied for mapping fields to column names. For example, the firstName field maps to the FIRST_NAME column. You can control this mapping by providing a custom NamingStrategy. See Mapping Configuration for more detail. Table and column names that are derived from property or class names are used in SQL statements with quotes by default. You can control this behavior by setting R2dbcMappingContext.setForceQuote(false), or use R2dbcMappingContext.forPlainIdentifiers() to create a context with plain (unquoted) identifiers.
items.translation: 短 Java 类名按以下方式映射到表名。 com.bigbank.SavingsAccount 类映射到 SAVINGS_ACCOUNT 表名。 相同的名称映射规则也应用于将字段映射到列名。 例如，firstName 字段映射到 FIRST_NAME 列。 您可以通过提供自定义的 NamingStrategy 来控制此映射。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅映射配置。 默认情况下，从属性名或类名派生的表和列名在 SQL 语句中使用引号。 您可以通过设置 R2dbcMappingContext.setForceQuote(false) 来控制此行为，或使用 R2dbcMappingContext.forPlainIdentifiers() 创建一个具有普通（未加引号）标识符的上下文。

items.source: By default, table and column names derived from classes and properties are used with database-specific quotes, meaning they are typically case-sensitive and reserved SQL words (such as order) can be used safely in names. To disable quoting, override r2dbcMappingContext(Optional<NamingStrategy>) in AbstractR2dbcConfiguration and return R2dbcMappingContext.forPlainIdentifiers(…), or call context.setForceQuote(false) on the context. When quoting is disabled, Spring Data converts identifier casing to the form used by the configured database without quoting. For databases that adhere to the SQL standard, names are converted to upper case, so you can use unquoted names when creating tables as long as you do not use keywords or special characters. The quoting character and the way names get capitalized is controlled by the used R2dbcDialect. See R2DBC Drivers for how to configure custom dialects.
items.translation: 默认情况下，从类和属性派生的表和列名称会使用数据库特定的引号，这意味着它们通常是区分大小写的，并且可以安全地在名称中使用保留的 SQL 单词（例如 order）。 若要禁用引号，请在 AbstractR2dbcConfiguration 中重写 r2dbcMappingContext(Optional<NamingStrategy>) 并返回 R2dbcMappingContext.forPlainIdentifiers(…)，或者在上下文中调用 context.setForceQuote(false)。 当禁用引号时，Spring Data 会将标识符的大小写转换为配置数据库所使用的形式，而不使用引号。 对于遵循 SQL 标准的数据库，名称会被转换为大写，因此只要不使用关键字或特殊字符，您就可以在创建表时使用未加引号的名称。 引号字符和名称的大写方式由使用的 R2dbcDialect 控制。 有关如何配置自定义方言，请参阅 R2DBC 驱动程序。

items.source: @Embedded: a property with this annotation will be mapped to the table of the parent entity, instead of a separate table. Allows to specify if the resulting columns should have a common prefix. If all columns resulting from such an entity are null either the annotated entity will be null or empty, i.e. all of its properties will be null, depending on the value of @Embedded.onEmpty() May be combined with @Id to form a composite id.
items.translation: @Embedded：带有此注解的属性将被映射到父实体所在的表，而不是单独的表。 允许指定生成的列是否应具有公共前缀。 如果由该实体生成的所有列均为 null，则根据 @Embedded.onEmpty() 的值，该注解实体将变为 null 或空（即其所有属性均为 null）。 可与 @Id 组合使用以形成复合主键。

items.source: @Version: Applied at field level is used for optimistic locking and checked for modification on save operations. A value of null for wrapper types (or zero for primitive types) marks the entity as new. The initially stored value is zero for wrapper types (one for primitive types). The version gets incremented automatically on every update. See Optimistic Locking for further reference.
items.translation: @Version：在字段级别应用，用于乐观锁，并在保存操作时检查修改。 对于包装类型，值为 null（或对于基本类型为 zero）表示实体为新实体。 初始存储的值对于包装类型为 zero（对于基本类型为 one）。 每次更新时版本号会自动递增。 有关更多信息，请参阅乐观锁。

items.source: By convention, Spring Data applies a NamingStrategy to determine table, column, and schema names defaulting to snake case. An object property named firstName becomes first_name. You can tweak that by providing a NamingStrategy in your application context.
items.translation: 按照约定，Spring Data 会应用一个 NamingStrategy 来确定表、列和模式名称，默认采用 蛇形命名法。 名为 firstName 的对象属性将变为 first_name。 您可以通过在应用程序上下文中提供一个 NamingStrategy 来调整此行为。

items.source: When the column naming strategy does not match your database column names, you can override the column name with the Column annotation. The element value of this annotation provides the custom column name. The following example maps the name property of the MyEntity class to the CUSTOM_COLUMN_NAME column in the database:
items.translation: 当列命名策略与数据库列名不匹配时，您可以使用 Column 注解覆盖列名。 该注解的 value 元素提供自定义列名。 以下示例将 MyEntity 类的 name 属性映射到数据库中的 CUSTOM_COLUMN_NAME 列：

items.source: @MappedCollection: Allows for configuration how a collection, or a single nested entity gets mapped. idColumn specifies the column used for referencing the parent entities primary key. keyColumn specifies the column used to store the index of a List or the key of a Map.
items.translation: ：允许配置集合或单个嵌套实体的映射方式。idColumn 指定用于引用父实体主键的列。keyColumn 指定用于存储 List 索引或 Map 键的列。

items.source: When the table naming strategy does not match your database table names, you can override the table name with the Table annotation. The element value of this annotation provides the custom table name. The following example maps the MyEntity class to the CUSTOM_TABLE_NAME table in the database:
items.translation: 当表命名策略与您的数据库表名不匹配时，您可以使用 Table 注解来覆盖表名。 该注解的 value 元素提供自定义表名。 以下示例将 MyEntity 类映射到数据库中的 CUSTOM_TABLE_NAME 表：

items.source: Some databases, such as Postgres, can natively write enum values using their database-specific enumerated column type. Spring Data converts Enum values by default to String values for maximum portability. To retain the actual enum value, register a @WritingConverter whose source and target types use the actual enum type to avoid using Enum.name() conversion. Additionally, you need to configure the enum type on the driver level so that the driver is aware how to represent the enum type.
items.translation: 某些数据库（例如Postgres）可以原生使用其特定的枚举列类型来写入枚举值。 Spring Data 默认将Enum值转换为String值，以确保最大兼容性。 若要保留实际的枚举值，请注册一个@WritingConverter，使其源类型和目标类型均使用实际的枚举类型，从而避免使用Enum.name()进行转换。 此外，您还需要在驱动层面配置枚举类型，以便驱动程序了解如何表示该枚举类型。

items.source: Rich mapping support is provided by the MappingR2dbcConverter. MappingR2dbcConverter has a rich metadata model that allows mapping domain objects to a data row. The mapping metadata model is populated by using annotations on your domain objects. However, the infrastructure is not limited to using annotations as the only source of metadata information. The MappingR2dbcConverter also lets you map objects to rows without providing any additional metadata, by following a set of conventions.
items.translation: MappingR2dbcConverter 提供了丰富的映射支持。MappingR2dbcConverter 拥有完善的元数据模型，能够将领域对象映射到数据行。该映射元数据模型通过您在领域对象上使用的注解进行填充。然而，基础设施并不局限于仅使用注解作为元数据的唯一来源。MappingR2dbcConverter 还允许您遵循一系列约定，在不提供任何额外元数据的情况下将对象映射到行。

items.source: By default, (unless explicitly configured) an instance of MappingR2dbcConverter is created when you create a DatabaseClient. You can create your own instance of the MappingR2dbcConverter. By creating your own instance, you can register Spring converters to map specific classes to and from the database.
items.translation: 默认情况下（除非显式配置），在创建DatabaseClient时会创建一个MappingR2dbcConverter实例。 您可以自行创建MappingR2dbcConverter的实例。 通过创建自己的实例，您可以注册 Spring 转换器，以将特定类映射到数据库或从数据库映射出来。

items.source: You can configure the MappingR2dbcConverter as well as DatabaseClient and ConnectionFactory by using Java-based metadata. The following example uses Spring’s Java-based configuration:
items.translation: 您可以使用基于 Java 的元数据来配置MappingR2dbcConverter以及DatabaseClient和ConnectionFactory。 以下示例展示了如何使用 Spring 的基于 Java 的配置：

items.source: @Value: This annotation is part of the Spring Framework. Within the mapping framework it can be applied to constructor arguments. This lets you use a Spring Expression Language statement to transform a key’s value retrieved in the database before it is used to construct a domain object. In order to reference a column of a given row one has to use expressions like: @Value("#root.myProperty") where root refers to the root of the given Row.
items.translation: @Value：此注解属于 Spring 框架。在映射框架中，它可以应用于构造函数参数。这使得您能够在使用检索到的数据库键值构建领域对象之前，使用 Spring 表达式语言语句对其进行转换。若要引用给定行中的某一列，需使用类似 @Value("#root.myProperty") 的表达式，其中 root 指代给定 Row 的根节点。

items.source: @Column: Applied at the field level to describe the name of the column as it is represented in the row, letting the name be different from the field name of the class. Names specified with a @Column annotation are quoted when forceQuote is enabled (default). For most databases, quoting means that these names are case-sensitive. It also means that you can use special characters in these names. However, this is not recommended, since it may cause problems with other tools.
items.translation: @Column：应用于字段级别，用于描述行中列的名称，使其可以与类的字段名不同。 当启用 forceQuote（默认情况下）时，使用 @Column 注解指定的名称会被加引号。 对于大多数数据库而言，加引号意味着这些名称是区分大小写的。 这也意味着您可以在这些名称中使用特殊字符。 然而，这不推荐，因为这可能会与其他工具产生问题。

items.source: If the Java type has a property whose name matches the given field of the input row, then its property information is used to select the appropriate constructor parameter to which to pass the input field value. This works only if the parameter name information is present in the Java .class files, which you can achieve by compiling the source with debug information or using the -parameters command-line switch for javac in Java 8.
items.translation: 如果 Java 类型具有与输入行给定字段名称匹配的属性，则使用其属性信息来选择要传递输入字段值的适当构造函数参数。 此功能仅在 Java `.class` 文件中存在参数名信息时才能生效，您可以通过在编译源代码时包含调试信息，或在 Java 8 中使用 `javac` 的 `-parameters` 命令行开关来实现这一点。

items.source: When storing and querying your objects, it is often convenient to have a R2dbcConverter instance to handle the mapping of all Java types to OutboundRow instances. However, you may sometimes want the R2dbcConverter instances to do most of the work but let you selectively handle the conversion for a particular type — perhaps to optimize performance.
items.translation: 在存储和查询对象时，拥有一个用于将所有 Java 类型映射到OutboundRow实例的R2dbcConverter实例通常非常方便。然而，有时您可能希望R2dbcConverter实例承担大部分工作，而让您针对特定类型选择性地进行转换——例如为了优化性能。

items.source: You can use the getCustomConverters method in AbstractR2dbcConfiguration to configure converters. The examples at the beginning of this chapter show how to perform the configuration with Java.
items.translation: 您可以使用 `AbstractR2dbcConfiguration` 中的 `getCustomConverters` 方法来配置转换器。本章开头的示例展示了如何使用 Java 进行配置。

items.source: Arbitrarily nested objects are not supported by convention. Use @Embedded for value objects that map to columns in the same table — see [entity-persistence.embedded-entities].
items.translation: 按惯例不支持任意嵌套的对象。 对于映射到同一表中列的值对象，请使用 `@Embedded` —— 参见 [entity-persistence.embedded-entities]。

items.source: AbstractR2dbcConfiguration requires you to implement a method that defines a ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: `AbstractR2dbcConfiguration` 要求您实现一个用于定义 `ConnectionFactory` 的方法。

items.source: You can configure a custom NamingStrategy by registering it as a bean. The NamingStrategy controls how the names of classes and properties get converted to the names of tables and columns.
items.translation:
您可以通过将其注册为 Bean 来配置自定义的 `<code>NamingStrategy`。  
该 `<code>NamingStrategy` 控制如何将类和属性的名称转换为表和列的名称。

items.source: Array of wrapper type (e.g. int[] → Integer[])
items.translation: 包装类型的数组（例如 int[] → Integer[]）

items.source: @Id: Applied at the field level to mark the primary key. It may be combined with @Embedded to form a composite id.
items.translation: @Id：应用于字段级别，用于标记主键。 它可以与 @Embedded 结合使用以形成复合主键。

items.source: The identifier property can be annotated with @Embedded allowing to use composite ids. The full embedded entity is considered the id, and therefore the check for determining if an aggregate is considered a new aggregate requiring an insert or an existing one, asking for an update is based on that entity, not its elements. Most use cases will require a custom BeforeConvertCallback to set the id for new aggregate.
items.translation: 标识符属性可以标注为 `@Embedded` 以支持复合主键。完整的嵌入实体被视为标识符，因此用于判断聚合根是新聚合（需要插入）还是已存在聚合（需要更新）的检查基于该实体本身，而非其元素。大多数使用场景都需要自定义一个 `BeforeConvertCallback` 来为新聚合设置标识符。

items.source: To selectively handle the conversion yourself, register one or more org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter instances with the R2dbcConverter.
items.translation: 若要自行选择性地处理转换，请将一个或多个 org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter 实例注册到 R2dbcConverter。

items.translation: 请注意，转换器仅应用于单个属性。 集合属性（例如 `Collection<Person>`）会进行迭代并逐个元素转换。 不支持集合转换器（例如 `Converter<List<Person>>, OutboundRow`）。

items.source: This section describes the features of the MappingR2dbcConverter, including how to use conventions for mapping objects to rows and how to override those conventions with annotation-based mapping metadata.
items.translation: 本节描述了MappingR2dbcConverter的功能，包括如何使用约定将对象映射为行，以及如何使用基于注解的映射元数据覆盖这些约定。

items.source: Read on the basics about Object Mapping Fundamentals before continuing with this chapter.
items.translation: 继续阅读对象映射基础，然后再继续本章内容。

items.source: MappingR2dbcConverter has a few conventions for mapping objects to rows when no additional mapping metadata is provided. The conventions are:
items.translation: MappingR2dbcConverter 在未提供额外映射元数据时，遵循若干将对象映射为行的约定。这些约定包括：

items.source: The converter uses any Spring Converters registered with CustomConversions to override the default mapping of object properties to row columns and values.
items.translation: 转换器使用通过CustomConversions注册的任意 Spring 转换器，以覆盖对象属性到行列和值的默认映射。

items.source: The fields of an object are used to convert to and from columns in the row. Public JavaBean properties are not used.
items.translation: 对象的字段用于在行中的列之间进行转换。 不使用公共的 `JavaBean` 属性。

items.source: If you have a single non-zero-argument constructor whose constructor argument names match top-level column names of the row, that constructor is used. Otherwise, the zero-argument constructor is used. If there is more than one non-zero-argument constructor, an exception is thrown. Refer to Object Creation for further details.
items.translation: 如果存在一个具有单个非零参数的构造函数，且该构造函数的参数名称与行的顶级列名匹配，则使用该构造函数。否则，使用无参构造函数。如果存在多个具有非零参数的构造函数，将抛出异常。有关更多详细信息，请参阅对象创建。

items.source: You can add additional converters to the converter by overriding the getCustomConverters method.
items.translation: 您可以通过重写 `getCustomConverters` 方法来为转换器添加额外的转换器。

items.source: To take full advantage of the object mapping functionality inside the Spring Data R2DBC support, you should annotate your mapped objects with the @Table annotation. Although it is not necessary for the mapping framework to have this annotation (your POJOs are mapped correctly, even without any annotations), it lets the classpath scanner find and pre-process your domain objects to extract the necessary metadata. If you do not use this annotation, your application takes a slight performance hit the first time you store a domain object, because the mapping framework needs to build up its internal metadata model so that it knows about the properties of your domain object and how to persist them. The following example shows a domain object:
items.translation: 要充分利用 Spring Data R2DBC 支持中的对象映射功能，您应该使用 @Table 注解来标记您的映射对象。 虽然映射框架并不需要此注解（即使没有任何注解，您的 POJO 也能正确映射），但该注解允许类路径扫描器发现并预处理您的领域对象，以提取必要的元数据。 如果您不使用此注解，在首次存储领域对象时，应用程序的性能会略有下降，因为映射框架需要构建其内部元数据模型，以便了解您领域对象的属性以及如何持久化它们。 以下示例展示了一个领域对象：

items.source: Can be customized by registering Explicit Converters.
items.translation: 可通过注册显式转换器进行自定义。

items.source: Array of T
items.translation: <T> 数组

items.source: Arrays of primitive types, wrapper types and String
items.translation: 基本类型、包装类型和String的数组

items.source: Contributed as a simple type by the used R2dbcDialect.
items.translation: 由使用的 `R2dbcDialect` 贡献为简单类型。

items.source: Target type depends on registered Converter.
items.translation: 目标类型取决于已注册的 Converter。

items.source: Requires a Explicit Converters, not supported otherwise.
items.translation: 需要显式转换器，否则不支持。

items.source: The RelationalConverter can use metadata to drive the mapping of objects to rows. The following annotations are available:
items.translation: RelationalConverter 可以使用元数据来驱动对象到行的映射。 以下注解可用：

items.source: @InsertOnlyProperty: Marks a property as only to be written during insert. Such a property on an aggregate root will only be written once and never updated. Note that on a nested entity, all save operations result in an insert therefore this annotation has no effect on properties of nested entities.
items.translation: @InsertOnlyProperty：标记该属性仅在插入时写入。在聚合根上的此类属性将仅被写入一次，且永远不会被更新。请注意，对于嵌套实体，所有保存操作均被视为插入，因此该注解对嵌套实体的属性无效。

items.source: @Sequence: specify a database sequence for generating values for the annotated property.
items.translation: @Sequence：指定用于为已注解属性生成值的数据库序列。

items.source: @Table: Applied at the class level to indicate this class is a candidate for mapping to the database. You can specify the name of the table where the database is stored.
items.translation: @Table：在类级别应用，表示该类是数据库映射的候选者。您可以指定存储该表的数据库名称。

items.source: @Transient: By default, all fields are mapped to the row. This annotation excludes the field where it is applied from being stored in the database. Transient properties cannot be used within a persistence constructor as the converter cannot materialize a value for the constructor argument.
items.translation: @Transient：默认情况下，所有字段都会映射到行中。此注解会排除应用该注解的字段不被存储到数据库中。瞬态属性不能在持久化构造函数中使用，因为转换器无法为构造函数参数生成值。

items.source: @PersistenceCreator: Marks a given constructor or static factory method — even a package protected one — to use when instantiating the object from the database. Constructor arguments are mapped by name to the values in the retrieved row.
items.translation:
@PersistenceCreator：标记一个给定的构造函数或静态工厂方法（即使是包级私有的），用于从数据库实例化对象。  
构造函数的参数通过名称映射到检索到的行中的值。

items.source: The mapping metadata infrastructure is defined in the separate spring-data-commons project that is technology-agnostic. Specific subclasses are used in the R2DBC support to support annotation based metadata. Other strategies can also be put in place (if there is demand).
items.translation: 映射元数据基础设施定义在独立的、与具体技术无关的 spring-data-commons 项目中。R2DBC 支持中使用了特定的子类来支持基于注解的元数据。如果存在需求，也可以部署其他策略。

items.source: You may use Spring Data’s SpEL support to dynamically create the table name. Once generated the table name will be cached, so it is dynamic per mapping context only.
items.translation: 您可以使用Spring Data 的 SpEL 支持来动态创建表名。生成后的表名会被缓存，因此仅在映射上下文中是动态的。

items.source: You may use Spring Data’s SpEL support to dynamically create column names. Once generated the names will be cached, so it is dynamic per mapping context only.
items.translation: 您可以使用Spring Data 的 SpEL 支持来动态创建列名。生成的名称会被缓存，因此仅在映射上下文中是动态的。

items.source: Attributes annotated with @ReadOnlyProperty will not be written to the database by Spring Data, but they will be read when an entity gets loaded.
items.translation: 使用 @ReadOnlyProperty 注解的属性不会被 Spring Data 写入数据库，但在加载实体时会被读取。

items.source: Attributes annotated with @InsertOnlyProperty will only be written to the database by Spring Data during insert operations. For updates these properties will be ignored.
items.translation: 使用 @InsertOnlyProperty 注解的属性，Spring Data 仅在插入操作时将其写入数据库。对于更新操作，这些属性将被忽略。

items.source: @InsertOnlyProperty is only supported for the aggregate root.
items.translation: @InsertOnlyProperty 仅支持聚合根。

items.source:
Spring Data will not automatically reload an entity after writing it.
Therefore, you have to reload it explicitly if you want to see data that was generated in the database for such columns.
items.translation: Spring Data 在写入实体后不会自动重新加载该实体。因此，如果您希望查看数据库中为这些列生成的数据，必须显式地重新加载该实体。

items.source:
If the annotated attribute is an entity or collection of entities, it is represented by one or more separate rows in separate tables.
Spring Data will not perform any insert, delete or update for these rows.
items.translation:
如果注释的属性是实体或实体集合，则它由不同表中的一个或多个独立行表示。  
Spring Data 不会对这些行执行任何插入、删除或更新操作。

items.source: Custom top-level entity conversion requires asymmetric types for conversion. Inbound data is extracted from R2DBC’s Row. Outbound data (to be used with INSERT/UPDATE statements) is represented as OutboundRow and later assembled to a statement.
items.translation: 自定义顶层实体转换需要不对称的类型。入站数据从 R2DBC 的 Row 中提取。出站数据（用于与 INSERT/UPDATE 语句配合使用）表示为 OutboundRow，随后被组装成语句。

items.source: AbstractR2dbcConfiguration creates a DatabaseClient instance and registers it with the container under the name of databaseClient.
items.translation: AbstractR2dbcConfiguration 会创建一个 DatabaseClient 实例，并将其注册到容器中，名称为 databaseClient。

items.source: R2DBC uses boxed primitives (Integer.class instead of int.class) to return primitive values.
items.translation: R2DBC 使用装箱后的基本类型（例如使用 Integer.class 而非 int.class）来返回基本类型的值。

items.source: The @Id annotation tells the mapper which property you want to use as the primary key.
items.translation: @Id 注解告诉映射器您希望用作主键的属性。
